newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shareholders okay Champion spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Shareholders okay Champion spinoff.

text.p: Champion Technology Holdings Ltd said on Thursday its shareholders had approved its proposal to spin off Kantone Holdings Ltd at an extraordinary general meeting.
Champion Technology said 159.17 million Kantone shares will be distributed to sharholders and dealing in the Kantone shares will commence on January 23.
In December, Champion Technology said it planned to distribute a total of 159.17 million shares of its proposed spin-off unit Kantone as special interim dividend to Champion shareholders.
The distributed Kantone shares, representing about 43 percent of the unit's issued capital, would be allocated on the basis of one-for-10 Champion shares held.
Kantone is mainly involved in the design, manufacture and distribution of radio telcommunications systems and equipment with production facilities in the United Kingdom and Malaysia.
